dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Post-infectious autoimmune brainstem-cerebellitis (Bickerstaff-like syndrome, seronegative) with bilateral abducens nerve palsies and pancerebellar ataxia
Alternatives:
1. Acute paraneoplastic cerebellar degeneration (occult malignancy not yet identified on CT CAP)
2. Whipple's disease with CNS involvement (rhombencephalitis)
3. Anti-mGluR1 or other antibody-mediated autoimmune cerebellitis
